name: HARDWARE - MITRE PLATE - 20 X 40 - 45 DEG - 2.0 STEEL
process: laser cut from 2.0 mm galvanized sheet: the rectangle, edges deburred; welded into the frame's mitre (J-FRAME-01)
material: pre-galvanized steel S280GD+Z (EN 10346) or SGC400 (JIS G3302), yield 280 MPa or more, Z100
